title: Consolidate grid token inheritance, prune auto-layout variants, and publish refreshed component library
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Problem: Our Figma library has grown many one-off component variants due to inconsistent token inheritance and ad-hoc responsive grid constraints. This increases file size, causes confusion for engineers mapping tokens to CSS variables, and leads to visual regressions when tokens are updated.

Goal: Simplify token inheritance for spacing/grid tokens, prune redundant auto-layout variants across Buttons, Tables, and Chart wrappers, enforce a concise naming convention for responsive variants, and publish a clean, documented library update. Ensure engineering has a stable token map and migration notes.

Scope: Buttons, Table row/cell components, Chart containers, and top-level grid/spacing tokens. Update Figma components and tokens only; implementation work will be tracked in ENG-4021.

Out-of-scope: Complete visual redesigns, theme introductions beyond the existing light/dark tokens, and third-party library integrations.
acceptance_criteria: Core spacing and grid tokens consolidated into a single token family (grid-1..grid-12) with documented inheritance rules in the Figma file.
Component variants reduced by at least 40% across Buttons, Tables, and Chart wrappers while preserving existing public instances via aliasing where possible.
Auto-layout constraints normalized (min/max widths, hugging/filling rules) and verified across three breakpoints in Figma prototypes.
Naming convention document added to the library (responsive suffixes, state tokens, size tokens) and applied to all updated components.
Publish completed: library published, changelog entry created, and a migration note shared with Engineering and Product listing breaking changes and mapping of old tokens to new tokens.
Design review sign-off from PM and Engineering (comments resolved) and a follow-up rollout plan for users with custom overrides.
A migration checklist and token mapping CSV attached for engineers.
No new accessibility regressions introduced; key components validated with color/contrast and keyboard focus checks.

Track any incoming bug reports and schedule follow-ups (post-publish)
decisions: Adopt 'rwd-grid-N' prefix for new grid tokens to avoid collisions with legacy 'spacing-*' tokens.
Reduce component variants by introducing token-driven state overrides instead of explicit variant duplication where feasible.
Use aliasing in Figma to preserve instances for customers who have overridden components rather than performing a destructive replace.
Publish as a minor library release (ui-kit-2025.02) with clear migration notes; do not auto-replace instances without explicit migration PRs.
blockers: ENG-4092: Legacy token references in codebase must be mapped to new tokens before a hard cutover.
DES-21747: Two table-cell layout regressions need fixes before publishing the library.
